name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_range
statement: ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (e q L : ℕ), (∀ a ∈ A, a < L) → q < L → ∀ a ∈ M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q, a < L
guidance: Split membership in insert q (A.erase e). The inserted case uses q<L; surviving membership implies membership in A. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
